description: Save a placement revision. Input requires expectedVersion and payload.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key. Reuse it when retrying the same mutation.

input.description: A revision containing from 1 to 50 placements plus the consent/runtime attestations preflight requires.

consentDeclaration.description: Attest that consent requirements are accounted for. Preflight requires true.

runtimeDeclaration.description: Attest that runtime placement behavior has been reviewed. Preflight requires true.

workspaceId.description: Activation workspace identifier returned by the start or status tool.

name: save_sulvo_placement_plan
